Name: Bait Converter
Author: Suntooth
Description:
[size=3]This mod adds a machine that will convert basic bait into a random targeted bait, and also targeted bait into a different random targeted bait - for when you want to get targeted bait for a specific fish but Willy just won't stock what you need.[/size]

[size=3]Currently the ratios are as follows, although I'm open to feedback if this feels unbalanced:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]5 Bait -> 2-4 Targeted Bait[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]3 Targeted Bait -> 2-3 Targeted Bait[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]The machine is unlocked at Fishing level 7 (one level higher than the Bait Maker), and is crafted using a Bait Maker and 15 Bait. There is also a more desaturated version of the sprite available in the config.[/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[size=3]Theoretically, the bait generated should also include bait for modded fish. If not, I am unlikely to add compatibility for specific mods.[/size]

[size=4][b]Self-promotion[/b][/size]
[size=3]Do you enjoy mods that let you do more with machines? You may enjoy [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52282]Dehydrate Your Vegetables[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49592]Deconstruct More Things[/url], or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12997]Age More Things[/url]![/size]
